title: Investigation of the mechanism of Prunella vulgaris in treatment of papillary thyroid carcinoma based on network pharmacology integrated molecular docking and experimental verification.
authors: Zhu, Xiling; Li, Yan; Wang, Xiaodong; Huang, Yuanshe; Mao, Jingxin
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究夏枯草治疗甲状腺癌的机制，虽涉及蛋白靶点但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅分子对接验证，与课题关联度低。
abstract: To analyze the molecular mechanism of Prunella vulgaris L. (PV) in the treatment of papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) by using network pharmacology combined with molecular docking verification. Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database and Analysis Platform database was used to predict the main active components of PV, Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database and Analysis Platform, PubChem, and Swiss Target Prediction databases were used to obtain the corresponding targets of all active components. Targets collected for PTC treatment through Gene Cards, Digest and Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man databases respectively. The Search Tool for the Retrieval of Interaction Gene/Protein database was used to obtain the interaction information between proteins, and the topology analysis and visualization were carried out through Cytoscape 3.7.2 software (https://cytoscape.org/). The R package cluster profiler was used for gene ontology and Kyoto encyclopedia of genes and genomes analysis. The "active ingredient-target-disease" network was constructed by using Cyto scape 3.7.2, and topological analysis was carried out to obtain the core compound. The molecular docking was processed by using Discovery Studio 2019 software, and the core target and active ingredient were verified. The inhibition rate was detected by CCK8 method. Western blot was used to detect the expression levels of kaempferol anti-PTC related pathway proteins. A total of 11 components and 83 corresponding targets in the component target network of PV, of which 6 were the core targets of PV in the treatment of PTC. It was showed that quercetin, luteolin, beta (beta)-sitosterol, kaempferol may be the core components of PV in the treatment of PTC. vascular endothelial growth factor A, tumor protein p53, transcription factor AP-1, prostaglandin endoperoxidase 2, interleukin 6, and IL-1B may be important targets for the treatment of PTC. The main biological processes mainly including response to nutrient levels, response to xenobiotic stimulus, response to extracellular stimulus, external side of plasma membrane, membrane raft, membrane microdomain, serine hydrolase activity, serine-type endopeptidase activity, antioxidant activity, etc IL-17 signaling pathway, and PI3K-Akt signaling pathway may affect the recurrence and metastasis of PTC. Kaempferol may significantly reduce the activity of Papillary cells of human thyroid carcinoma bcpap cell lines cells compared with quercetin, luteolin, beta-sitosterol. Kaempferol may reduce the protein expression levels of interleukin 6, vascular endothelial growth factor A, transcription factor AP-1, tumor protein p53, 1L-1B and prostaglandin endoperoxidase 2, respectively. PV has the characteristics of multi-components, multi-targets and multi- pathways in the treatment of PTC, which network pharmacology help to provides a theoretical basis for the screening of effective components of PV and further research.
abstract_zh: 采用网络药理学结合分子对接验证的方法，分析夏枯草（Prunella vulgaris L., PV）治疗甲状腺乳头状癌（papillary thyroid carcinoma, PTC）的分子机制。利用中药系统药理学数据库与分析平台（Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology Database and Analysis Platform）预测PV的主要活性成分，并通过该平台、PubChem和Swiss Target Prediction数据库获取所有活性成分的对应靶点。分别通过Gene Cards、Digest和在线人类孟德尔遗传数据库（Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man）收集PTC治疗相关靶点。利用检索相互作用基因/蛋白质的搜索工具（Search Tool for the Retrieval of Interaction Gene/Protein）数据库获取蛋白质间的相互作用信息，并通过Cytoscape 3.7.2软件（https://cytoscape.org/）进行拓扑分析和可视化。使用R包cluster profiler进行基因本体论和京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto encyclopedia of genes and genomes）分析。利用Cytoscape 3.7.2构建“活性成分-靶点-疾病”网络，并进行拓扑分析以获得核心化合物。使用Discovery Studio 2019软件进行分子对接，验证核心靶点和活性成分。通过CCK8法检测抑制率。使用Western blot检测山柰酚（kaempferol）抗PTC相关通路蛋白的表达水平。PV成分靶点网络中共有11个成分和83个对应靶点，其中6个为PV治疗PTC的核心靶点。结果表明，槲皮素（quercetin）、木犀草素（luteolin）、β-谷甾醇（beta (beta)-sitosterol）和山柰酚可能是PV治疗PTC的核心成分。血管内皮生长因子A（vascular endothelial growth factor A）、肿瘤蛋白p53（tumor protein p53）、转录因子AP-1（transcription factor AP-1）、前列腺素内过氧化物酶2（prostaglandin endoperoxidase 2）、白细胞介素6（interleukin 6）和IL-1B可能是治疗PTC的重要靶点。主要生物过程包括对营养水平的响应、对异源刺激的响应、对细胞外刺激的响应、质膜外侧、膜筏、膜微域、丝氨酸水解酶活性、丝氨酸型内肽酶活性、抗氧化活性等。IL-17信号通路和PI3K-Akt信号通路可能影响PTC的复发和转移。与槲皮素、木犀草素和β-谷甾醇相比，山柰酚可能显著降低人甲状腺癌bcpap细胞系的活性。山柰酚可能分别降低白细胞介素6、血管内皮生长因子A、转录因子AP-1、肿瘤蛋白p53、IL-1B和前列腺素内过氧化物酶2的蛋白表达水平。PV治疗PTC具有多成分、多靶点、多通路的特点，网络药理学有助于为PV有效成分的筛选和进一步研究提供理论基础。
